output.summary: The codebase is a diagram authoring and experimentation system built around immutable diagram revisions and revision-bound canvas composition. Browser editing, agent tools, generated alternatives, and Git change proposals converge on shared canvas commands and history. Persistence, source evidence, reusable agent contexts, and evaluation workflows form the main supporting boundaries; static architecture analysis is a separate tooling subsystem.

points.title: Runtime Composition and APIs
points.rationale: The backend composition root connects application services to filesystem stores, model runtimes, browser bridges, and language services. Its Vite adapter exposes the core and mapping APIs, translates errors, controls optional capabilities, and owns shutdown. This is the strongest anchor for understanding deployment and dependency wiring.

relationships.label: Constructs and injects durable repositories
Wires canvas services and WebSocket transport
Constructs chat runtime and tool bindings
Connects push ingestion to proposal workflows
Assembles evaluation services and generation reconciliation

points.title: Immutable Diagram Revisions
points.rationale: Diagram identity, parsed ASCII content, logical node continuity, source mappings, and revision ancestry meet here. Creation and editing issue validated immutable revisions; the runtime registry preserves their identity. This separates diagram content from its placements and provides the shared foundation for editing, generation, comparison, and persistence.

points.title: Canvas Commands and History
points.rationale: MappingDocumentController is the shared semantic mutation boundary for browser edits and isolated proposals. It validates versions and operation batches, coordinates placements and connections, and delegates checkpoints, named views, branching, and undo history to CanvasHistoryService. Canvas checkpoints bind exact diagram revisions independently of composition and personal view state.

relationships.label: Binds and revises immutable diagram content
Produces incremental checkpoint records
Retains diagram context bindings in checkpoints

points.title: Interactive Canvas Runtime
points.rationale: CanvasWorkspace owns document-session lifetimes, while CanvasSession exposes separate reactive stores for document, presentation, selection, controls, and status. The tldraw adapter owns live geometry and native undo navigation, committing settled gestures through the domain controller. Shape projection and routing connect semantic diagrams to interactive rendering without persisting every pointer frame.

relationships.label: Owns controllers and commits settled gestures
Submits workspace changes and publication requests
Registers browser canvases and handles dispatched commands
Hosts chat with the active canvas context

points.title: Checkpoint and Catalog Persistence
points.rationale: Persistence separates immutable content and checkpoint records from mutable manifests and published catalog entries. Browser changes become incremental record batches with version checks and retry identities; server stores publish references after backing records exist. This boundary supports durable history, efficient current-state reads, publication, and atomic acceptance of multi-canvas changes.

relationships.label: Stores and restores validated immutable revisions
Serializes checkpoint graphs and exact revision bindings

points.title: Source Evidence and Navigation
points.rationale: Source access resolves a diagram's explicit repository binding instead of assuming one repository per project. Mapped nodes resolve to source ranges, corpus providers supply bounded repository-relative access, and optional language-service sessions resolve definitions against verified source hashes. These constructs connect visual diagrams to inspectable backing code.

relationships.label: Resolves node mappings and diagram source evidence
Loads published source bindings and revisions

points.title: Live Canvas Agent API
points.rationale: AgentDiagrammingSessionService exposes canvas reads and mutations through HTTP-backed MCP tools and a constrained JavaScript execution runtime. A command bridge reaches the owning browser, while LiveCanvasService maintains separately bound selection streams. Compact anchor projection, version checks, and retry receipts preserve identity across these transport boundaries.

relationships.label: Dispatches live commands to the owning browser
Uses shared semantic commands and current-state projections
Starts and monitors diagram edit batches
Routes proposal-scoped reads and mutations
Exposes saved and diagram-bound context operations

points.title: Reusable Agent Contexts
points.rationale: AgentContext models a validated, hash-addressed conversation and source-evidence snapshot that can seed independent model sessions. The library adds durable discovery, forks, comments, and lineage; source adapters retain exact Git content or immutable snapshots. Diagram-bound contexts reuse this machinery while detecting changes to their captured evidence.

relationships.label: Compiles reusable context from diagram evidence
Captures and resolves repository source ranges
Uses immutable records for captured source content

points.title: Validated Diagram Generation
points.rationale: DiagramEditService and DiagramBatchService coordinate asynchronous creation, extension, scoped replacement, and alternatives against pinned input revisions. Model execution remains behind generator ports; validated submission and domain revision issuance precede application. Runs distinguish generation from application acknowledgement so ambiguous retries do not regenerate or duplicate edits.

relationships.label: Validates generated edits and issues revisions
Seeds generation with captured context
Applies prepared revisions through versioned canvas ports

points.title: Agent Chat Orchestration
points.rationale: AgentChatService manages persisted conversations, native thread resume, streaming events, turn-bound tools, and alternative generation through a Codex app-server connection. GenerationCanvasBridge supplies each candidate with an isolated controller behind the same canvas port. This makes chat both an interactive client of canvas tools and a coordinator of independent generated alternatives.

relationships.label: Invokes tools bound to the current chat turn
Owns isolated controllers for generated alternatives
Loads saved contexts for independent child conversations
Generated alternatives are reconciled into evaluation runs

points.title: Git Change Proposals
points.rationale: ChangeSessionService captures repository-scoped canvas baselines and Git hunks, edits isolated proposals, derives review changes, and accepts ready proposals only against unchanged originals. A two-stage agent workflow analyzes and materializes proposals; push ingestion resolves pinned commit endpoints and deduplicates external events before starting that workflow.

relationships.label: Edits isolated proposals with shared controllers
Persists proposal records and atomically publishes acceptance
Uses canvas tools during proposal materialization
Runs validated sequential agent workflow steps

points.title: Generation Evaluation Workbench
points.rationale: Evaluation runs pin prompts, contexts, canvas inputs, and output provenance across workflows and repeated samples. Comparisons capture independent snapshots; experiments organize conditions and attempts; judgements preserve typed assessments. Completed outputs can be promoted through the same catalog publication boundary, making this a substantial product subsystem rather than test infrastructure.

relationships.label: Pins and resolves shared evaluation inputs
Reuses persisted agent-session execution
Reads checkpoint records and publishes promoted outputs
Captures proposal results as evaluation outputs
Preserves exact canvas histories for comparisons

points.title: Static Architecture Analysis
points.rationale: A separate TypeScript analysis pipeline extracts containment, lexical references, calls, ownership, and dependencies with explicit evidence provenance. It supports incremental reuse, partition metrics, deterministic artifacts, and joins from pinned diagram leaf ranges to source entities. The inspected CLI invokes it independently of the interactive backend.

relationships.label: Defines joins from pinned diagram leaves to source entities

limitations: The requested complete source read was not achieved. All 1,044 inventory entries received a source-level survey using declarations, test descriptions, or short excerpts; reviewedPaths lists the files examined beyond that survey. Several large listed files were inspected selectively rather than in full.

Most test bodies, peripheral UI components and styles, benchmark implementations, migration scripts, the standalone projection-3d prototype, and Python parser tooling did not receive detailed implementation review. Parser and static-analysis internals were only partially inspected.
The index excludes corpus data, investigations, artifacts, generated stores/builds, vendor dependencies, node_modules, documentation other than the root README, binary/assets, and lockfiles.
Relationships describe inspected static wiring and call paths. No application, tests, model runtimes, or external integrations were executed; no live repository or external sources were consulted.
